summary:
The fix for R2-M1 (obligation O-016) is in the tree and works, and I found nothing new to file.

**What moved.** Between f513faf and 79891f4 only two files changed besides slice records:
- `.taad/fitness.yaml`: the new rule's pattern and its `because` text.
- `eng/rules-harness/plants.json`: plant rows S11 and S12, and a `_note` saying 34 rows.

Nothing under `src/` or `tests/window` changed, so round 1's window-case runs still describe the shipped code.

**How the new pattern behaves.** I loaded it through the engine's own YAML load and ran `taad3.fitness.check` on a scratch copy of MainWindow.xaml, planting after the `<DockPanel Margin="16">` anchor as the harness does:
- The single-quoted scalar loads to exactly the intended regex.
- It stays quiet on the clean tree, which includes OutcomeTexts with its `ScrollViewer.Style` block and DriveScroller.
- S09, S10, S11 and S12, taken from plants.json itself, each fire at line 107.
- It also fires on:
  - a ListView on one line;
  - a DataGrid behind two comments and a `ScrollViewer.Resources` block;
  - a `>` inside a single-quoted attribute.
- It stays quiet, correctly, on a self-closing ScrollViewer followed by a sibling list, and on a list inside a Grid (outside the rule's direct-child scope, as designed).

The only further miss is a self-closing `<ScrollViewer.Resources />` before the list. An empty property element like that is not a realistic shape, so I have not filed it.

**Readers of the edited files are unaffected:**
- Fitness check on the real tree: every rule holds.
- rules-parity: AGREE, still 47 settled entries.
- RuleCases C-001 to C-005: exit 0.
- The 14 xUnit Rule tests: passed.

**Statements elsewhere.** The MainWindow.xaml comment ("The architecture rule in .taad/fitness.yaml fails a list written straight inside a ScrollViewer here") and the S09 note are still accurate. The row count of 34 matches the file.

The C-012 deferral ("enforced by the contract comment and the ScrollViewer rule") now holds.

Second round: The rule this attempt ships at `.taad/fitness.yaml:810` fires on legitimate XAML, so it needs one more fix. I proposed this exact pattern in the previous review (R2-M1), so the defect is mine.

**What goes wrong.** The pattern allows `<!--.*?-->` (and `<ScrollViewer.X>.*?</ScrollViewer.X>`) any number of times between the ScrollViewer tag and the list. Under `(?s)`, a lazy `.*?` still grows past the first `-->` when the rest of the pattern fails, so the match can run on to a later `-->` anywhere in the file.

MainWindow.xaml already has such a later comment: the one ending at line 443, directly above `<TreeView x:Name="FolderTree"` (line 444). So one comment written in the house style inside either existing ScrollViewer makes the rule fail on a ScrollViewer that holds no list.

**Measured with the engine's `taad3.fitness.check`** on scratch copies of MainWindow.xaml:
- The clean tree passes.
- A comment as the first child of DriveScroller fails at line 114.
- A comment between OutcomeTexts' `</ScrollViewer.Style>` and its StackPanel fails at line 289.

**The fix.** Bounding both inner spans with a tempered token is enough: `<!--(?:(?!-->).)*-->` and `(?:(?!</ScrollViewer\.\1>).)*`. On the same copies the bounded pattern:
- stays quiet on the clean tree and on both legitimate comments;
- still fires on S09–S12, '>' inside an attribute, and a DataGrid after two comments and a `ScrollViewer.Resources` block;
- stays quiet on a self-closing ScrollViewer followed by a sibling list.

**Other readers of the edited files are unaffected.** They were checked in the previous pass: rules-parity AGREE, RuleCases C-001 to C-005, and the 14 Rule xUnit tests. Nothing else in the diff adds a parser or matcher. No file under `src/` changed.

findings.claim: The SL-065 rule fires on legitimate XAML. Its comment alternative `<!--.*?-->` and property-element alternative `<ScrollViewer\.(\w+)\b[^>]*>.*?</ScrollViewer\.\1>` are lazy but unbounded under (?s), so when the rest of the pattern fails they grow past the first `-->` (or closing tag) to a later one anywhere in the file. MainWindow.xaml already has a comment ending at line 443 directly above `<TreeView x:Name="FolderTree"` (line 444). So a comment in the house style placed first inside DriveScroller, or after OutcomeTexts' `</ScrollViewer.Style>`, makes the rule report a list inside a ScrollViewer that holds only a StackPanel. The next slice that comments either element gets a false failing gate, pointing at line 114 or 289. The easy way out of that is to weaken or drop the rule. No plant row covers a legitimate comment inside a ScrollViewer, so plants.json cannot catch this.
findings.fix:
At .taad/fitness.yaml:810, bound both inner spans with a tempered token:
`'(?s)<ScrollViewer\b(?:"[^"]*"|''[^'']*''|[^>"''])*(?<!/)>(?:\s|<!--(?:(?!-->).)*-->|<ScrollViewer\.(\w+)\b[^>]*>(?:(?!</ScrollViewer\.\1>).)*</ScrollViewer\.\1>)*<(ListView|TreeView|ListBox|DataGrid)\b'`
Measured with the engine on the same copies:
- quiet on clean, on the DriveScroller comment and on the OutcomeTexts comment;
- fires on S09, S10, S11, S12, '>' in an attribute, and comment + `ScrollViewer.Resources` + comment + DataGrid;
- quiet on the self-closing sibling.
Then add a quiet plant row (expect fitness: quiet, xunit: quiet) to eng/rules-harness/plants.json: insert-after the unique anchor `</ScrollViewer.Style>` with the text `<!-- the texts -->`, so this false positive cannot return unnoticed.

obligations.evidence: .taad/fitness.yaml:810 now holds the single-quoted pattern, which loads to `(?s)<ScrollViewer\b(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^>"'])*(?<!/)>(?:\s|<!--.*?-->|<ScrollViewer\.(\w+)\b[^>]*>.*?</ScrollViewer\.\1>)*<(ListView|TreeView|ListBox|DataGrid)\b`. eng/rules-harness/plants.json has S11 (comment between the tags) and S12 (ScrollViewer.Style block before the list). Engine check on a scratch copy: clean passes; S09 to S12 each fire at 107; the self-closing sibling stays quiet.

No src change since f513faf. S-002 and the S-008 maximized runs from round 1 stand: OutcomeTabs keeps its height across the tab click, and the unselected list reads inView=false with fullRows=0 (WindowReport.cs InView and FullRows).
No src change. S-007 read stripRows=1 with the header 'Unreadable folders (12,345)' at 560. My WPF probe showed the StripRows formula reads 2 when the strip wraps.
Test-C001 unchanged and passed in round 1.
Test-S003 unchanged and passed; MainWindow.xaml.cs HideSection and EnsureSelectedTabIsVisible unchanged.
Test-S006 and B-008 unchanged and passed.

cases.evidence: Still deferred as material:false, and the reason now holds. The rule it relies on fires on the house-style shapes (comment between the tags: S11; ScrollViewer.Style block first: S12). I verified this with the engine on a planted scratch copy.

drift: No departure the build did not declare. The rewritten `because` text is declared. One small inaccuracy in it: it says plant rows S09-S12 'prove the harness matches across newlines', but eng/rules-harness/harness.py still exits 2 at this HEAD. The rows have been proven only through the engine's fitness.check called directly, as the build's follow-up says.
No departure the build did not declare. The pattern is the reviewer's, character for character, as declared. The defect in it is filed as finding M1, not as drift.
